messages.en:
{07 14 00}Hey,{01 00 00 05 00} {04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00} this
amazing letter arrived in
my mailbox the other day.
I've been wanting to show it
to you in particular,{01 00 00 0a 00}
{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Hei,{01 00 00 05 00} {04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00} mu
postkasti saabus hiljuti
hämmastav kiri.
Tahtsin seda just sulle
näidata,{01 00 00 0a 00}
{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
Hey,{01 00 00 05 00} {04 1f 00},{07 14 00} I want to
show you one of my most
prized possessions.
It's this totally bizarre
letter that I found in my
mailbox, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
Hei,{01 00 00 05 00} {04 1f 00},{07 14 00} tahan sulle
näidata üht oma kõige
hinnalisemat vara.
See on täiesti veider kiri,
mille leidsin oma
postkastist, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 0e 00}This is someone looking for
advice on a problem, right,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}?
messages.et:
{07 0e 00}See on keegi, kes otsib
nõu mure kohta, eks,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}?

messages.en:
{07 13 00}I think this is a fan
letter, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 0d 00}Huh huh huh!{01 00 00 0a 00} I don't really
understand it, but I looove
getting mail,{01 00 00 0a 00} {04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 0d 00}Hah hah haa!{01 00 00 0a 00} Ma ei saa
sellest päriselt aru, aga
post meeldib,{01 00 00 0a 00} {04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 00 00}It's kind of confusing, but
I'm into it!{01 01 00} {07 0d 00}It's like a
code I have to crack!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}See on veidi segane, aga
mulle meeldib!{01 01 00} {07 0d 00}See on nagu
kood, mille pean murdma!
